findings.seen: The photographs show the athlete with dark brown, wavy hair pulled back into a high ponytail at the crown, with no parting or fringe, and some loose strands escaping around the face. This hairstyle is consistent across all four images.
The photographs show a young woman with a compact, athletic build, featuring strong legs and comparatively softer arms, consistent with the description provided.

Photo 2 shows a copper short-sleeved t-shirt with a lighter copper raglan seam running from the neckline to the underarm. It features a pale cream badge on the left chest with clipped top corners and a rounded bottom, containing a copper diving bird. There are no other visible marks, logos, or lettering.
Photos 2 and 3 show plain copper athletic shorts, cut to mid-thigh, with an elasticated waistband and a loose fit, lacking any stripes, piping, or side panels.
Photo 3 shows plain white ankle socks sitting just above the shoe collar, with no visible stripes or bands.
Photo 3 shows entirely white court shoes, including white uppers, laces, and soles, with no contrast colors or visible branding.

Photo 2 shows a paddle on the bench with a blank light beige face, a black edge guard, and a black wrapped handle. Beside it are a plain towel and an unlabelled clear water bottle. No ball is visible in any of the photographs.
Photo 2 shows the club crest positioned on the left chest, appearing small in size.
